title: The Whole Tide
author: Yara Almeida
blurb: Jude Pemberton, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
